AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

3. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.

4. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.

5. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

8. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

10. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.

11. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.

12. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

13. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Controls and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
